items.title: Pete Candoli interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999
items.q: which was the Mussolini type thing, it was the marching song

ctx.x: Oh. 1929 wasn’t it? The Chicago World’s Fair.

I think so. And the big thing about it was an Italian general by the name of Italo Balbo was bringing non-stop from Italy, a squadron of Italian Army planes, and they were tri- winged, three wings, and as it went over Mishawaka, which is about a hundred miles, right near where South Bend is, a hundred miles from Chicago, everybody was waving flags, and you’d see, here they are, and you’d hear these things. And I remember we started playing “The Fascista Song,” which was the Mussolini type thing, it was the…
